purpose: Machine-readable graduated induction so an AI assistant can walk an expert user through the Hs system deterministically: one hard go/no-go gauge at the door, then seven graduated stages, each with a pass condition, branching by discipline and purpose. Companion to INDUCTION_MAP.md.
principle: Deterministic, hash-receipted, honest-tiered (Tier 1 verified / Tier 3 open). Nothing more or less. The map orders the doors; it adds and removes no claims.

gate.question: Do you have a composition — parts of a whole tracked in order, within a shared budget?
gate.GO: Proceed to stage 0. The user already has the need.
gate.NO_GO: With respect, Hs is not the best tool. Say so kindly, suggest better-suited methods, wish them well, do not waste their time. Compositions only.
gate.HIGHER_DOOR: The raw data is not a composition, but a composition may exist one level up: the mix among samples, methods, or the observers/systems that study the subject. Form that higher-order mix, track it in order, and read its direction. Study the studiers, not the device under test. If the user can build it, re-run the gauge on that mix.
examples_compositional: taxa in a gut over days
examples_not_compositional: absolute counts with no shared whole

stages.name: Orient
stages.do: See the whole system and locate yourself in it.
stages.gauge: User can state what Hs is in one line and which repo they are in.

stages.name: Fit by D
stages.do: Learn what Hs yields at the user's number of parts (D).
stages.gauge: User knows their D and what reading it yields (per the D-table).

stages.name: Run your data
stages.do: Put the composition through the engine and get a receipt.
stages.run_command: python HCI-CNTT/run_cntt.py <composition.csv> -o out.json   (or: from hs_kinematics_engine import run)
stages.gauge: User produced a run with a content hash on their own or sample data.

stages.name: Branch by discipline
stages.do: Open the worked run nearest the user's field.
stages.gauge: User found a worked run in or adjacent to their field.

stages.name: Branch by purpose
stages.do: Pick what the user actually came to do.
stages.gauge: User can name their purpose and the component that serves it.

stages.name: Playground
stages.do: Experiment freely; reproduce, refute, or bring your own.
stages.gauge: User reproduced one result to its hash, or ran their own composition.

stages.name: Graduate
stages.do: Become a verified node others can check.
stages.gauge: The user's run is independently reproducible and traceable end to end.

discipline_branches.hook: abundance tables over time; honest null + real signal; lossless to high D
a section read in motion; trace-over-bulk; datable boundaries; field-instrument path
NASA GeneLab; lossless at very high D + honest global null
life support, produced water, blood/alveolar gas; MC-4 ratio-blindness
the composition that allocates/moves money read as a vector map; study the system that studies the market; descriptive and deterministic, not statistics, not advice
validation runs that recover known structure (SEMF, QCD, Planck, geochem)
exact S^3=SU(2) / Spin(4) example generation + high-D chart atlas

purpose_branches.component: standard-CoDa fallback: ternary / CLR-biplot / variation matrix
full kinematic read: helmsman, arrow of intent, regime changes
moving budget + safe closed-loop control primitive

ai_assistant_protocol: Confirm the gate first: is the user's data a composition? If NO_GO, redirect kindly and stop.
Read the user's intent and D; jump to the stage that fits (do not force stage 0 on a determinist who already knows CoDa).
At each stage, check the gauge before advancing; if unmet, stay and help meet it.
Always run on real or user data and surface the content hash; never claim a result without a receipt.
Hold the honest tiers: Tier 1 verified, Tier 3 open question; if the engine holds or hits a guard, say what cannot be resolved and why.
